faq.helpLine: Can't find your answer? Email us at hello@qtable.ai — a human replies within an hour, every day of the week.

savvy.q: Do I need to be tech-savvy?
savvy.a: Not at all. If you can take a photo with your phone, you can use Qtable. Upload your menu and we do the rest — no training needed.

price.q: What if I change a price tomorrow?
price.a: Edit any dish from your phone and it updates instantly. The QR on your tables never changes — it always shows your latest menu.

wifi.q: Does it work without restaurant wifi?
wifi.a: Yes. Your diners use their own phone data or your wifi. Our menus are tiny and load in under a second, even on a weak signal.

scans.a: Never. Every tier comes with unlimited scans.

expired.q: What happens if my subscription expires?
expired.a: Your public menus stay live, so guests scanning existing QR codes can still view them. Dashboard editing, new menus, uploads, and AI photo tools pause until you pick a plan again.

domain.q: Can I use my own domain?
domain.a: Yes. Point your domain to us and we handle the rest, including the secure certificate.
